Comments: A significant interoperability workshop was held Nov 2025 (organized by Terre des Hommes, Ministry of Health, funded by Enabel/Wehubit) to transfer technical skills on health information system interoperability. The system is under active development toward interoperability. National Health Information System modernization is a stated priority.
